children: New Delhi, Sept. 23 -- IRB Infra shares looked set to snap their 7-day losing run on Wednesday, 23 September, after the company's board approved monetising non-core assets. IRB Infrastructure Developers share price opened at Rs.18.32 against its previous close of Rs.17.98 and rose by 3.5% to an intraday high of Rs.18.61.
